control.detail: The formation path's only non-test consumer in the whole of src is src/simulation/demo.ts. Nothing in an ordinary save calls it, so no belief is ever formed in a game anybody plays.

measuredBy: research queue lane, on the hardcoded-content audit lane's lead

measurements.found: recordPrivateBelief is defined at politics.ts:93 and referenced by political-belief-formation.ts:283 and by demo.ts:229. The formation module itself is imported by demo.ts and re-exported by the simulation barrel at index.ts:207, which is not a caller. So the only non-test caller of the whole apparatus is the demo.
measurements.what: Every reference to recordPrivateBelief and to the political-belief-formation module across src, excluding tests

playerReachDetail: Nothing a player does causes anyone, themselves included, to form or change a view.

surface.detail: No screen shows what a person believes, what they have said, or that they have changed their mind.

system.detail: Fully built at both ends. src/simulation/politics.ts carries recordPrivateBelief and its companions, and src/simulation/political-belief-formation.ts is a complete formation path on top of them.

title: What a person privately believes, says publicly, and has changed their mind about
